name: Snare
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' SNAR: two decaying pulses into two fixed-interval tonal resonators, and a decaying noise burst into a third, high resonator, all self-enveloping and summed. A note strikes shorter the higher it is played.

controls.label: Snap
controls.description: The noise burst's peak level, and past noon, how long both the snap and the tone ring.

controls.label: Tone
controls.description: Balances the two tonal resonators, which sound at the note itself and an octave above it.

controls.label: Snap balance
controls.description: Crossfades the tonal sum against the snap resonator. Centred is the module's own unweighted sum.

controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Widens the interval between the two tonal resonators: unison at 0, the module's octave at noon, two at 1.
